verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a browser extension, mobile apps, a CLI and an integrated TOTP generator, but no first-party desktop application. The CLI and browser extension do run on a computer, but they are different surfaces from a first-class desktop app, so they earn no credit here. A community wish for fingerprint auth on Linux does not affirmatively establish a desktop app.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
